name: chair pose utkatasana
description: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.
instructions: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.
